target: 100% completion across the chosen Windows route and required Saturn-exclusive content, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, title screen, character selector, and local save directory.
areas.note: Primary route: original Windows release. Secondary route: Sega Saturn exclusives only.

levels.1: Check the edition before creating the completion saves.
levels.2: Install Resident Evil (1996) from its current GOG or Steam Windows release.
levels.3: Install the unmodified original Windows game from GOG or Steam, select the intended language, and launch once. Confirm the title offers Jill and Chris without Director's Cut or Rebirth mode labels; those versions have separate packs.

levels.1: Keep a dated copy before branching or attempting a no-save clear.
levels.2: Back up the active language's SAVE folder before each ending cleanup block.
levels.3: Close the game completely, copy the current language's SAVE directory to a dated folder, and keep each character's clear data separate. Restore files only while the game and cloud synchronization are closed.

levels.1: Her larger inventory and lock pick make a practical first mapping run.
levels.2: Finish one full Windows campaign with Jill and create clear data.
levels.3: Select Jill from New Game, solve every mandatory area, read her route-only files, and finish through the final result. Save the clear data when prompted so her weapons, Special Key, and costumes can be tested on a new cycle.

levels.1: His smaller inventory and small-key route change several interactions.
levels.2: Finish one full Windows campaign with Chris and create clear data.
levels.3: Select Chris from New Game, account for six inventory spaces, collect Small Keys for locked drawers, and finish through the result. Save the clear data separately so his weapon and costume unlocks remain available.

levels.1: Each character has two independent optional route flags.
levels.2: Reserve save slots for four Jill outcomes and four Chris outcomes.
levels.3: Keep a pre-branch backup for each character, label whether the support route is active, and record whether the optional laboratory cell was opened. The four combinations per character produce every ending without revealing their scenes in advance.

levels.1: Use separate columns for permanent files and version-specific equipment.
levels.2: Track 15 files, five maps, every physical weapon, and all clear-data weapons.
levels.3: Mark each file only after it appears in the file menu, each map after its area plan opens, and each weapon after handling it. Keep Windows and Saturn checklists separate because their exclusive firearms and bonus content differ.

levels.1: One official console port contains content absent from Windows.
levels.2: Use the Sega Saturn release for its exclusive campaign details and Battle Game.
levels.3: Run an original Saturn disc or a legally dumped copy in a tested Saturn emulator. Keep a Saturn save with at least one campaign clear; use it for both characters' Battle Game runs, the exclusive outfits, and the platform-only enemy placements.

areas.name: Windows Clear-Data Unlocks
areas.location_cue: The result screen, clear-data prompt, New Game inventory, first item box, and mansion dressing room.
areas.note: Windows uses a zero-save rule for the infinite launcher and a four-hour rule for its two exclusive firearms.

levels.1: A clear-data condition adds this item to a later New Game inventory.
levels.2: Meet this Windows condition: jill clear under four hours.
levels.3: Finish a Windows run as Jill with the result timer below 4:00:00 and save the clear data. Load that clear data into New Game and confirm the infinite-ammunition Ingram MAC-10 appears in the starting inventory.

levels.1: A clear-data condition adds this item to a later New Game inventory.
levels.2: Meet this Windows condition: chris clear under four hours.
levels.3: Finish a Windows run as Chris with the result timer below 4:00:00 and save the clear data. Load that clear data into New Game and confirm the infinite-ammunition Minimi appears in the starting inventory.

levels.1: A clear-data condition adds this item to a later New Game inventory.
levels.2: Meet this Windows condition: complete without saving.
levels.3: Begin a fresh Windows campaign and never use a typewriter. Pausing and item boxes are safe, but any recorded save invalidates the attempt. Finish, create clear data, load that data into New Game, and confirm the Infinite Rocket Launcher is in the starting inventory.

levels.1: A clear-data condition adds this item to a later New Game inventory.
levels.2: Meet this Windows condition: jill ending a clear.
levels.3: Complete Jill Ending A with the support flag active and the optional cell opened, then save clear data. Load that clear data into New Game, open the first item box, and take the Special Key before visiting the first-floor dressing room.

levels.1: A clear-data condition adds this item to a later New Game inventory.
levels.2: Meet this Windows condition: chris ending a clear.
levels.3: Complete Chris Ending A with the support flag active and the optional cell opened, then save clear data. Load that clear data into New Game, open the first item box, and take the Special Key before visiting the first-floor dressing room.

levels.1: A best-route clear opens a previously locked mansion wardrobe.
levels.2: Use Jill's Special Key on the inner dressing-room door and select her first alternate outfit.
levels.3: Load Jill's Ending A clear data, take the Special Key from the first item box, and enter the dressing room beside the first-floor gallery. Unlock the inner wardrobe, change once, leave the room, and confirm Jill keeps the first alternate outfit.

levels.1: The same wardrobe contains another PC-exclusive appearance.
levels.2: Re-enter Jill's unlocked dressing room and select her second alternate outfit.
levels.3: On Jill clear data with the wardrobe already unlocked, return to the first-floor dressing room and interact with the costume point again until the other alternate PC outfit is worn. Exit to the corridor and confirm the appearance persists.

levels.3: Load Chris's Ending A clear data, take the Special Key from the first item box, and enter the dressing room beside the first-floor gallery. Unlock the inner wardrobe, change once, leave the room, and confirm Chris keeps the first alternate outfit.

levels.2: Re-enter Chris's unlocked dressing room and select his second alternate outfit.
levels.3: On Chris clear data with the wardrobe already unlocked, return to the first-floor dressing room and interact with the costume point again until the other alternate PC outfit is worn. Exit to the corridor and confirm the appearance persists.

items.label: Combine the Timed and Zero-Save Unlocks

levels.1: One disciplined run can satisfy two weapon conditions for each character.
levels.2: Clear Jill once and Chris once below four hours without saving.
levels.3: Plan a practiced route, never use a typewriter, and finish each character below 4:00:00. Using the already unlocked Ingram or Minimi on later attempts does not invalidate the zero-save condition. Save only when the result offers clear data.

areas.name: Sega Saturn Exclusive Pass
areas.location_cue: The Saturn title screen, original campaign tunnels and laboratory, plus the 15-room Battle Game route.
areas.note: This secondary pass contains the only required platform-exclusive content for the 1996 entry.

levels.1: The bonus combat mode normally appears after one completed campaign.
levels.2: Finish either character's Saturn campaign and save the clear data.
levels.3: Complete one original Saturn campaign, remain through its result, and save when prompted. Return to the title screen and confirm Battle Game is available before overwriting the clear file.

levels.1: This port replaces several familiar underground encounters with a distinct creature type.
levels.2: During a Saturn campaign, inspect the brown insect-like creatures in the underground tunnels.
levels.3: Reach the Saturn underground route with either character and enter every tunnel room before using the medal fountain. Encounter and defeat at least one brown insect-like replacement creature, then continue to a save so the exclusive-content pass is documented.

levels.1: Chris's Saturn laboratory route contains one additional mandatory room encounter.
levels.2: Play Chris on Saturn and clear the extra creature encounter in the late laboratory.
levels.3: Use Chris on the original Saturn build, progress through the powered laboratory rooms, and enter the late culture-tank route before the central elevator. Defeat the additional large laboratory creature and confirm the next door opens; its identity is intentionally withheld here.

levels.1: A second controller changes both characters' starting appearances.
levels.2: At the July 1998 screen, hold L and R on controller two, then press Start on controller one.
levels.3: Connect two Saturn controllers. On the July 1998 screen, hold both shoulder buttons on controller two without releasing them, press Start on controller one, and begin a campaign. Verify the selected character is wearing the Saturn-exclusive appearance.

levels.1: Apply the two-controller code before selecting her campaign.
levels.2: Enable the Saturn costume code, select Jill, and reach playable control in the alternate outfit.
levels.3: Enter the costume code at the date screen, start Jill's campaign with controller one, and open the inventory after control begins. Continue through one door so the exclusive outfit is clearly visible and recorded.

levels.1: Apply the two-controller code before selecting his campaign.
levels.2: Enable the Saturn costume code, select Chris, and reach playable control in the alternate outfit.
levels.3: Enter the costume code at the date screen, start Chris's campaign with controller one, and open the inventory after control begins. Continue through one door so the exclusive outfit is clearly visible and recorded.

levels.1: The normal clear unlock can also be tested through a two-controller input.
levels.2: With any Saturn save present, keep controller two's X, Y, Z, and Start depressed while controller one presses Start.
levels.3: Keep at least one save on the Saturn memory device. At the title screen, depress X, Y, Z, and Start together on controller two; while they remain down, tap Start on controller one and check Options for Battle Game. Repeat the input after returning to the title screen if the entry disappears.

levels.1: Conserve powerful ammunition for the last rooms and use supply rooms deliberately.
levels.2: Select Jill and defeat every enemy across all 15 Battle Game rooms.
levels.3: Arrange Jill's opening inventory in room 1, clear every occupied room before approaching its exit, and replenish only in the three supply rooms. Defeat the gold-coloured final enemy in room 15 and remain through the score table until Jill's clear is recorded.

levels.1: His smaller inventory makes ammunition order and healing reserves more important.
levels.2: Select Chris and defeat every enemy across all 15 Battle Game rooms.
levels.3: Arrange Chris's six-slot inventory in room 1, reserve the strongest ammunition for large enemies, and use each supply room before proceeding. Clear room 15 and remain through the score table until Chris's result is recorded.

items.label: Earn Battle Game S with Jill

levels.1: Remaining health, completion speed, unused ammunition, and spare healing all contribute.
levels.2: Finish Jill's Battle Game run with at least 1,000 points for S rank.
levels.3: Move quickly between cleared doors, avoid unnecessary damage, use ordinary ammunition before premium rounds, and preserve healing supplies when safe. Finish all 15 rooms, then verify Jill's result totals 1,000 points or more and displays S.

items.label: Earn Battle Game S with Chris

levels.1: Efficient inventory changes and clean large-enemy fights protect the score.
levels.2: Finish Chris's Battle Game run with at least 1,000 points for S rank.
levels.3: Prepare the next weapon during supply-room pauses, minimize healing use, and avoid wasting ammunition on cleared targets. Complete all 15 rooms, then verify Chris's result totals 1,000 points or more and displays S.

items.label: Inspect Every Battle Game Enemy Variant

levels.1: Several rooms contain port-exclusive visual variants not found in Windows.
levels.2: During either complete Battle Game run, inspect the special uniformed zombie and gold-coloured final enemy.
levels.3: Do not rush past room 12 or room 15. In room 12, identify and defeat the unusually durable uniformed zombie among the ordinary group. In room 15, circle the gold-coloured large enemy once before finishing the run; no additional item unlock follows.
